theorems.name: Submission.fiw_im_series
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn U n) (c : ℕ → ℤ), (∀ r, IsIntegerMultiplicity (T r)) → (∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → (∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (T r).massOn W) < ∞) → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n, (∀ ω, HasSum (fun r => (c r : ℝ) * T r ω) (S ω)) ∧ (∀ W, S.massOn W ≤ ∑' r, ((c r).natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * (T r).massOn W) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
